name: 32_Collar_Safety_Slider
description: Pull toward heel by 5 mm before turning collar; push forward after locking. Captive under rails with M2 shoulder screw. No spring or automatic relock is claimed.

name: 33_Captive_Collar_Right
description: One of two collar halves assembled around fixed shoulders using two M2 through bolts and nuts at X151.5/Z+/-29. Rotate -30 degrees after retracting slider. Validate screw bearing, print fit, fatigue and torque.

name: 40_Captive_Collar_Left
description: Matching collar half. Split is away from head lugs. 0.30 mm seam. Fasteners are installed once; head changes require no screw removal.

name: 06_Fixed_Contact_Carrier
description: Four embedded pad/tail reserves; M2 attachment uses original panel supports. Supplier contact hardware and PCB design remain to be selected.

name: 10_Vibration_Head_Body
description: R03 vibration chamber with new stationary four-contact connection and common collar lugs.

name: 11_Vibration_Dome_Cap
description: Retained R03 dome and coin motor pocket. Cleaning/contact-surface validation is unresolved; no disposable barrier has been validated.

name: 37_Head_Contact_Carrier
description: Removable four-pin spring-contact reserve, two M2 screws. Pins remain aligned while outer collar rotates.

name: 38_Joint_Male_Coupon
description: Exact pilot, key and lugs. Use with female coupon and collar before a complete handle print.

name: 39_Joint_Female_Coupon
description: Exact socket and collar shoulders. Assemble the two collar halves around this coupon using the same M2 through bolts.

name: REF_OLED_Adafruit938_35p6x33x6p2
description: Published Adafruit 938 envelope. Active area 29.42 x 14.70; screen aperture 30.4 x 15.8. Centered active-area location is provisional; verify current PCB drawing/sample.

description: Proposed plated contact land; schematic assignment GND / regulated supply / motor control / head ID. No hot-swap claim.

name: REF_Power_Slide_Switch
description: SS12D00G3-style slide switch envelope. Adhesive retained under heel slot. Switch EN only, not servo supply current.

name: REF_Vibration_Driver_Reserve_6x20x10
description: Custom 20 x 10 x 6 max perfboard: AO3400A MOSFET, flyback diode, gate resistor and pull-down. Mount in head with adhesive pad; 5 V supply.

name: 41_R04_Joint_Adaptor
description: R04 mechanical twist-lock interface. Four M3 x 8 button-head bolts join the head chassis. Electrical contacts are a separate unfinished R04 subsystem; use the cable port for initial bench testing.

name: 42_Magnetic_Chassis
description: Print open side upward. Includes 2.4 mm compression and 1.0 mm extension stops, spring seats, M3 nut pockets and cable exit. Clear holes and fit coupons first; no sliding bearing touches the carriage during measurement.

name: 43_Removable_Lid
description: Four M3 x 10 screws. Center-front M3 x 25 service screw is removed completely during sensing. Insert its M3 nut from below before fitting the cover.

name: 44_Moving_Carriage
description: Two parallel leaf springs, no rubbing guide. Magnet pocket 6.4 x 3.5 mm; M2 retained cap. R04 bayonet plus added M2 lock screw. Large rear shoulder meets chassis overload stops. Service-pin bore is in the large travel-stop shoulder.

name: 45_Leaf_Clamp_1
description: Spring clamp (inner pair has relieved corners): M2 x 10 screws, nuts in rear seat. Two screws lie outside the 12 mm-wide spring strip; do not drill the spring material.

name: 45_Leaf_Clamp_2
description: Spring clamp (inner pair has relieved corners): M2 x 10 screws, nuts in rear seat. Two screws lie outside the 12 mm-wide spring strip; do not drill the spring material.

name: 45_Leaf_Clamp_3

name: 45_Leaf_Clamp_4

name: 46_Magnet_Retainer
description: Two M2 x 10 screws; opening is smaller than magnet diameter. Thin adhesive layer prevents movement within the clearance pocket.

name: REF_Magnet_6x3_Axial
description: 6 mm diameter x 3 mm thick axially magnetized N35–N42 disc; pole faces normal to device axis. Fix orientation before calibration.

name: 47_Adjustable_Hall_Mount
description: DRV5055A3QLPG TO-92 pocket: 4.6 mm width, 3.3 mm depth, open top. Flat sensing face toward magnet. ±1 mm axial adjustment gives nominal 7.2–9.2 mm package-face gap. Two M3 x 6 screws; strain-relieve stationary wires.

name: REF_DRV5055A3QLPG_Envelope
description: TI LPG package maximum-envelope reference, not detailed manufacturer CAD; pin 1 VCC, 2 GND, 3 OUT. Flat face at X171 toward magnet.

name: REF_Hall_Lead_1
description: Solder insulated leads before seating sensor; no wire crosses moving carriage.

name: REF_Hall_Lead_2
description: Solder insulated leads before seating sensor; no wire crosses moving carriage.

name: REF_Hall_Lead_3
description: Solder insulated leads before seating sensor; no wire crosses moving carriage.

name: 48_Locking_Filament_Cartridge
description: Same R04 quarter-turn geometry, plus radial M2 lock pocket; press flange against receiver face while clamping. Unrated nylon references only. Cartridge lock screw must be loosened before turning; install service pin first.

name: REF_Nylon_Unrated
description: 0.9 mm diameter / 38 mm length is an uncalibrated layout reference. A monofilament that buckles below a target cannot apply that target force.

name: 49_Bench_Calibration_Cartridge
description: Rigid broad pad for pressing against a reference balance; NEVER a skin-testing substitute. Swap for filament cartridge after mechanical/sensor calibration; recalibrate assembled cartridge as needed.

name: 55_Spring_Assembly_Bridge
